confidence_notes: Brisbane cost-of-living aggregates support the meal, coffee and beer estimates; current data is closer to October than the requested July window. Cocktail data is thin and is about 1.75 times the local pub-beer price; the wine-glass estimate is inferred at about 1.25 times beer. Accommodation estimates are holistic and less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Brisbane-specific cost-of-living data. Accommodation is estimated from general norms for hostels and budget-to-midscale hotels in large Australian cities.
